mapper.update: UPDATE service_task_operation SET version=#{version},status=#{status},attempts=#{attempts},state_json=#{stateJson},updated_at=#{updatedAt},next_attempt_at=#{nextAttemptAt},lease_until=#{leaseUntil},poll_at=#{pollAt} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND command_digest=#{digest} AND target_digest=#{targetDigest} AND progress='PENDING'
UPDATE service_task_operation SET poll_at=#{pollAt} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND progress='PENDING'
UPDATE service_task_operation SET progress=#{progress},progressed_at=#{progressedAt},poll_at=NULL WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND progress='PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM service_task_operation WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id}
SELECT * FROM service_task_operation WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM service_task_operation WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND process_instance_id=#{processInstanceId} AND execution_id=#{executionId} AND node_id=#{nodeId}

SELECT q.tenant_id,q.id,q.trace_id,a.business_no,CASE WHEN a.id IS NOT NULL THEN q.process_instance_id ELSE NULL END AS process_instance_id FROM service_task_operation q LEFT JOIN approval_application a ON a.tenant_id=q.tenant_id AND a.id=q.application_id WHERE q.poll_at<=#{pollAt} AND q.progress='PENDING' ORDER BY q.poll_at,q.created_at,q.id LIMIT 10
SELECT * FROM service_task_operation WHERE tenant_id=#{argument1} AND application_id=#{argument2} AND round_no=#{argument3} ORDER BY created_at,id LIMIT #{argument4}

SELECT * FROM service_task_operation WHERE tenant_id=#{argument1} AND application_id=#{argument2} AND round_no=#{argument3} AND (created_at>#{argument4} OR (created_at=#{argument5} AND id>#{argument6})) ORDER BY created_at,id LIMIT #{argument7}
